<b>Twelfth Architect</b> is a [[NPCs (Silksong)#Merchants|merchant]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It sells wares at its shop in the [[Underworks]] in exchange for [[Rosaries]] and [[Craftmetal]].

== Background ==
Twelfth Architect is an [[Architects|Architect]] built by [[the Citadel]] to serve [[Pharloom]] by creating mechanical tools.<ref>Twelfth Architect: <i>"Bug-Red. Do you ask-need our service? We shall create, as is our d-d-directive. To serve, for Pharloom eternal."</i></ref> It is the only Architect still functional within the Citadel.<ref>Twelfth Architect: <i>"One cannot. The skill to construct an Architect... That was taken by t-t-time. I am the last-final. The core remains to sustain the song, but no more Architects to tend-toil or build anew."</i></ref> The Architects learned some of their skill from the [[Weavers]].<ref>Twelfth Architect: <i>"An Architect's work owes much to the art of the f-f-first children. They set expert standard for the tools and talents of Pharloom eternal."</i></ref>

Twelfth Architect is old and beginning to shut down due to its advanced age.<ref>Twelfth Architect: <i>"T-t-t-too long I have worked. From my mind-vault, the imprint has f-f-faded. With many things it is like this... remembrance, dimmed..."</i><br>Twelfth Architect: <i>"Long now I have felt my rotors slow their s-s-spin. My limbs lift weak. An ending is felt, coming, sudden-certain...welcome."</i></ref> It appears to be overriding its original directive with some of its own feelings and opinions.<ref>Twelfth Architect: <i>"To build-automate is not choice. It is our nature-directive-c-c-c-cage."</i><br>Twelfth Architect: <i>"Long before the c-c-creation of the core, the sentinels ventured, even beyond these walls, to see all bugs brought-forced safe to serve the Citadel."</i></ref>

== In-game Events ==
Twelfth Architect sells goods to [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] in exchange for [[Rosaries]] and [[Craftmetal]]. After Hornet finds the [[Ruined Tool]] in [[Weavenest Murglin]], Twelfth Architect can convert it into the [[Silkshot]].

After Hornet collects 25 [[Tools]], Twelfth Architect sells [[Architect's Key]], which unlocks [[Chapel of the Architect]].

After all of Twelfth Architect's items have been bought (with the exception of the Silkshot, even if Hornet has acquired the [[Ruined Tool]]) and Hornet has acquired the [[Architect's Melody]], talking with Twelfth Architect reveals that its end is coming. Later, it can be found motionless at its desk, and a [[Pristine Core]] can be collected from the floor. A [[Silk Fly]], presumably the one that animated the Architect, will be resting on its head and will fly away once approached.

|Title1_Event2 = Opening the shop
|Title1_Dialogue2 = Bug-Red. Do you ask-need our service? We shall create, as is our d-d-directive. To serve, for Pharloom eternal.
|Title1_Event3 = After acquiring the [[Ruined Tool]]
|Title1_Dialogue3 = A fine artefact you carry there, Bug-Red. That broken tool, it is Weaver-make?<br>
{{HTalk|I believe so, Master. A relic of their old workshop, lost in fetid caves beyond this Citadel.}}<br>
{{HTalk|The parts suggest a weapon of thread, one I would attempt to repair myself, had I endless time.}}<br>
An Architect's work owes much to the art of the f-f-first children. They set expert standard for the tools and talents of Pharloom eternal.<br>
If you desire-demand, I can remake the tool, though my own mind-directives may produce u-u-u-nique result.
|Title1_Event4 = After acquiring the [[Architect Crest]]
|Title1_Dialogue4 = {{HTalk|Master, I have communed with the shrine above. Your learnings are unique, techniques born of cogwork hearts. Their mastery will require some commitment on my part.}}<br>
Bug-Red, you are the first organic shell to fuse our memories. S-s-s-such behaviour, my line would have believed improbable-impossible.<br>
Still, your broad arsenal did suggest strong affinity with the m-m-m-mechanical craft, enough to allow access to our thought-store.<br>
{{HTalk|Yours is an impressive skill, Master. I am grateful for the insight.}}
|Title1_Event5 = After acquiring [[Cogheart]] or [[Cogheart Pieces]]
|Title1_Dialogue5 = Those pieces of a h-h-heart-core you carry upon you, how did you acquire-recover an artefact so rare?<br>
{{HTalk|They were scattered about the Citadel, each seemingly laid with purpose. Someone wished the thing dismantled, but showed respect enough to see it stored safe.}}<br>
That heart is an inspired form, conceived by the first of my line for a knight of cog and blade.<br>
In it, I see my predecessor's talent, immense, now lost-forgotten. I could never create-copy a work s-s-so fine.<br>
{{HTalk|And the knight that once bore the heart? Tell me of them.}}<br>
A gleaming order, cogwork sentinels, so impressive-majestic in function they were charged-b-b-bound to the highest holy duty.<br>
Long before the c-c-creation of the core, the sentinels ventured, even beyond these walls, to see all bugs brought-forced safe to serve the Citadel.<br>
If the h-h-h-heart were restored within the sentinel's shell, would it give thanks for the awakening? Or would it grieve those lands now l-l-lost?<br>
{{HTalk|In time, maker, I may find out...}}
|Title1_Event6 = Asking about the [[Architect's Melody]]
|Title1_Dialogue6 = {{HTalk|Master, I seek a melody held by your line, one part of a sequence, and key to ascending above the Citadel. Can you teach it to me?}}<br>
Our melody? I r-r-recall! Yes! There was melody, once, but its sound... that I possess no longer...<br>
T-t-t-too long I have worked. From my mind-vault, the imprint has f-f-faded. With many things it is like this... remembrance, dimmed...<br>
But you m-m-may hear it, still. At the height of our core, there is means-s-s-system, near complete... Constructs old-built to sound our song. They need only be set to functional form.
|Title1_Event7 = Returning before obtaining the Architect's Melody
|Title1_Dialogue7 = Are you still to c-c-climb our grand core, Bug-Red? Within you may marvel at the work of Architects, my own, and all those passed b-b-before. <br>
{{HTalk|My path takes me in many directions, Master, but in due course, I will ascend the core and claim the melody atop it.}}
|Title1_Event8 = After acquiring the Architect's Melody
|Title1_Dialogue8 = What's this, Bug-Red? Even down here, I d-d-did detect its working... Have you climbed our c-c-core, and woken the voices of my l-l-line?<br>
{{HTalk|I have, maker. Clearly it was a climb never intended for regular bugs, and fair fortune that the skills gifted within your lands allowed my ascent.}}<br>{{HTalk|The melody, and the voices... both are fine things heard and witnessed. Even in this fading moment, their artistry shines through.}}<br>
Impressive-industrious... eternal... You have seen a glimpse, Bug-Red, of us-s-s, how once we were. The minds of Architects inspired. What majesty we did create...
|Title1_Event9 = After acquiring the Architect's Melody and purchasing all goods
|Title1_Dialogue9 = My s-s-service to you, Bug-Red... As it concludes, I must speak-confess. Long now I have felt my rotors slow their s-s-spin. My limbs lift weak. An ending is felt, coming, sudden-certain...welcome. <br>{{HTalk|Whatever fading you feel has not shown in your craft, Master. You have provided tools of immaculate make.}} <br>{{HTalk|What will follow if you pass? Would another take your place?}}<br>One cannot. The skill to construct an Architect... That was taken by t-t-time. I am the last-final. The core remains to sustain the song, but no more Architects to tend-toil or build anew.<br>S-s-strange... 'For Pharloom eternal,' states the d-d-directive-cage. But how can eternity sustain without an Architect to serve? This seems e-e-error. An end? An error... welcome?
|Title1_Event10 = Playing the [[Needolin]]
|Title1_Dialogue10 = [n]...To mend...Unending...<br>
...To serve...Eternal...<br>
...Always an Architect...<br>
...From these thoughts...Creation...<br>
...From these memories...Skill...<br>
...Designs...Divine...<br>

Twelfth Architect can be found in the [[Underworks]]. It can be accessed using the [[Clawline]] or the [[Faydown Cloak]].
